description: This Java class defines a configuration object for JWT subject issuer details, including issuer name and subject issuer information, with standard methods for access, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: JwtSubjectIssuerConfig
classes.description: Immutable configuration class holding issuer string and SubjectIssuer object, used for JWT subject issuer setup.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare JwtSubjectIssuerConfig instances based on issuer and subjectIssuer fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to provide hash based on issuer and subjectIssuer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object including class name, issuer, and subjectIssuer.
